description: Larger frame & stunning looks - This 27.5" EMTB features a sleekly integrated battery, longer range and premium components for a thrilling trail run.

components.description: Increased brake response & stopping power, with less wear and tear. Logan hydraulic disc brakes are the way to go for serious off-road riders who want the best brake performance and safety.

Removable Battery: Covering an average range of 50+ miles, this sleekly integrated 36V 14Ah Lithium-Ion battery features fast charging capability from 0 to 100% in 4-6 hours using the same proven battery management system as electric cars.
This Vinka 350W brushless rear hub motor features a responsive torque curve to deliver whisper-quiet power to your pedals, with perfect balance for traditional riding without resistance.
The Vinka DS20 Smart Display features speedometer, odometer, battery indicator, and backlighting. Easily switch from 5-level pedal assist, walk-assist, and traditional riding at your fingertips.
Suntour's XCT hydraulic suspension fork with lockout features 4" of travel allowing exceptional shock absorption for smoother riding.
Adjustable seat height to suit a variety of comfortable positions for all rider sizes.
Customize your ride with Shimano 24-speed gearing for quick and precise gear changes. Excel in any terrain with ease using more responsive torque.
27.5 x 2.1" CST All Terrain Tires from an internationally recognized brand you can trust where the rubber meets the trail. Hybrid tread provides excellent grip in all surface conditions.

Engineered to fly down trails with ease, this stunning E-MTB will take you there and back. Featuring hydraulic disc brakes, lockout suspension fork, unparalleled power, longer range, and ergonomic geometry.
Power up your pedaling with a 350W brushless geared hub motor for assisted speeds of 20 mph. The 504 Wh battery provides range to 50+ miles.

Featuring hydraulic disc brakes and hydraulic suspension fork with lockout, the Osprey assures you the safest braking and responsive shock absorption possible whether you're on gravel roads or descending stairs.
